Title: Charlotte Irigoga: I Now Feel Ready to Lead
NewsSummary: Charlotte's remarkable journey of balancing motherhood, career, and a master's degree
NewsContent:
A mother of two, including a newborn during her studies, Charlotte Irigoga defied the odds to balance the intense demands of motherhood, a full-time career, and a rigorous master's programme at Aga Khan University's Graduate School of Media and Communications (GSMC).

Looking back on her journey, Charlotte reflects on the immense challenges she faced. "There was a moment I found myself working on an assignment just days after giving birth," she recalls. "I remember thinking, 'I've done my best, and if I fail, it's okay.'" In addition to sleepless nights with a newborn, she attended in-person classes with her baby in tow, navigating the delicate balance of nursing, studying, and working full-time.

Despite the overwhelming pressures, Charlotte discovered a resilience within herself she never knew existed. "The experience taught me so much about myself," she says. "It taught me resilience, time management, and how to remain focused even when it seemed impossible." The hands-on, practical nature of the program allowed Charlotte to immediately apply what she was learning in real-world situations, boosting her confidence and increasing her effectiveness at work.

One of the most significant changes Charlotte experienced was her newfound proficiency with digital platforms. "The program helped me engage with digital tools in a way I never had before," she shares. "It changed how I connect with audiences and has already made me more competitive in my field."

As Charlotte completed her Master of Arts in Digital Journalism degree, she noticed not only an enhancement in her skill set but also a growing sense of confidence. The programme, she believes, has positioned her to take the next step in her career. "I now feel ready to take on a mid-level executive role," she says. "This degree isn't just a qualification-it's a transformative experience that has prepared me for the evolving demands of our industry."

Looking ahead, Charlotte envisions a bright future where she can make meaningful contributions to her career and the industry. With a new set of skills, a strong professional network, and a renewed sense of purpose, Charlotte is ready to thrive in the next chapter of her life.

When she reflects on her time at GSMC, Charlotte is filled with gratitude. "It's been an incredible journey," she says. "There were moments I doubted myself, but this program gave me the tools I needed to push forward."

For anyone considering the MA DJ programme, Charlotte has this to say: "Go for it. This program changed my life, and I know it can do the same for others. The challenges will be there, but the rewards are worth it."
